page.layout: One printed page, no text. A blind-stamped or gilt oval ornament (an emblem or ex-libris device) in the centre of the page; stains and show-through only.
page.notes: The page is an empty leaf (a binding or endpaper side) bearing only a gold-tooled oval device in the centre and dark water or ink stains at the upper right, lower right and left edge. The gilt device carries no legible printed words; no text is transcribed. The dark marks are stains, not text.
